pages.title: Potash Fertilizer
pages.text: Use Potash Fertilizer on a plant that accepts bonemeal. A successful use grows the plant through the normal bonemeal behavior and releases warm-colored dripping particles. Unsupported blocks do not consume it.
Prometheum tools and armor offer other farming abilities. Read the Prometheum material entry if you want to grow a workshop's own crop and fuel supply.
